# 5 · Business rules

> Invariable domain constraints. Identified by `BR-NNN`. Cited by use cases (ch. 4) and by the technical analysis. When a rule changes, the code, the tests, and the technical analysis **must** change in the same unit of work.

## BR-001 — Context identifier generated by the system

A Context `Id` is **always** generated by the system (GUID v4). The client cannot propose or influence it. Guarantees global uniqueness even across import/export scenarios.

## BR-002 — Mandatory Context fields

`Name` and `Description` are mandatory fields at the **contract** level: they must be present in the payload. In this version there is no non-emptiness validation: an empty string is formally accepted but considered bad practice (curator's responsibility, see A1).

## BR-003 — Replacement update semantics

`PUT /contexts/{id}` has **full replacement** semantics for the editable fields (`Name`, `Description`). There is no partial-patch operation. To change only one field, the client must resend the other one as it stands.

## BR-004 — Cascade Snippet deletion

Deleting a Context **also deletes all its Snippets**. Snippets cannot survive the Context that contains them (see glossary: a Snippet lives only inside a Context).

## BR-005 — Snippet identifier generated by the system

Same rule as `BR-001` applied to a Snippet: the `Id` is generated by the system.

## BR-006 — `UpdatedAt` maintenance on Context

Any write operation touching a Context — updating its fields (`UC-004`) or adding a Snippet (`UC-006`) — refreshes the Context's `UpdatedAt` to the current moment. Read operations **do not** alter `UpdatedAt`.

## BR-007 — Search match

The `UC-007` search returns a Snippet if at least one of the following contains the query in a **case-insensitive** way:

- the Snippet `Title`;
- the Snippet `Content`;
- at least one of its `Tags`.

The match is *substring* (contains), not prefix, not whole-word. There is no diacritic or special-character normalization: `città` and `citta` are different strings.

## BR-008 — Empty query = full enumeration

A search request with the `q` parameter absent or made of whitespace only is semantically equivalent to "return all Snippets of the Context". It is not an error.

## BR-009 — Snippet isolation per Context

Search operates **only** on the Snippets of the indicated Context. There is no cross-Context search in this version (see ch. 1, out of scope).
